summary: CDT Equity Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a material definitive agreement: a $2,126,250 senior secured convertible promissory note issued September 14, 2026 to J.J. Astor Co. under an amended June 11, 2026 loan agreement. The note matures March 1, 2027, payable in 24 weekly installments of $88,593.75, with $1,575,000 gross and $1,501,850 net funded. The company also issued warrants for 3,468,500 shares at $0.25, expiring in five years. The note is first-priority secured, and specified ATM proceeds must be applied to prior notes first. This is a financing, not a special situation.
